richiami.difetto: The affected tyres may have been manufactured with irregular geometry in the sidewall (shoulder) area of the tyre. Under certain circumstances this irregular geometry may lead to a sidewall crack at the shoulder area which may cause air loss leading to a risk of accident.
richiami.modello: Yokohama Truck Tyre 126S tyre size 385/55R22.5 158L , Yokohama Truck Tyre 126S tyre size 385/55R22.5 158L
richiami.titolo: Title of Recall	Voluntary recall of Yokohama truck tyre

richiami.difetto: The sidewall construction is not to specification which could lead to sudden failure of the sidewall and rapid deflation of the tyre.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the tyres.
